headline: Las Vegas Sands (LVS) Stock Looks Pricey With Cash Flow In Focus
summary: Las Vegas Sands stock has fallen about 29.3% year to date, yet the valuation picture is split, with the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate pointing to a premium while market multiples suggest the shares could be cheap on earnings and asset based measures. The year to date decline of 29.3% has reset expectations, which puts more focus on whether the current price already reflects softer sentiment toward Las Vegas Sands. Future cash flow from its resort and gaming portfolio...
